entries.title: Steering MoE LLMs via Expert (De)Activation (SteerMoE)

quotes.text: Our primary evaluation is based on the FaithEval benchmark suite (Ming et al., 2025), which includes three challenging datasets:

FaithEval-Unanswerable: The answer-bearing sentence is removed from the context. To remain faithful, the model should respond with "unanswerable" rather than relying on memorized knowledge. This is reinforced via explicit instructions in the prompt.

FaithEval-Counterfactual: Context passages have factual content deliberately altered to counterfactuals. A faithful model should generate answers based solely on the modified context, even if it contradicts the LLM's parametric knowledge.
FaithEval-Inconsistent: The context consists of multiple documents, each providing a conflicting answer.

entries.rationale: The paper states its primary faithfulness evaluation is based on the FaithEval benchmark suite and describes all three FaithEval subsets it evaluates on.
